name.en: Probe: where the game reads ability scores and when it rebuilds the values made from them
name.ja: 計測: ゲームが能力値を読む所と、そこから作る値を組み直す時

description.en: Records when update_ability_scores / update_max_hp run and what they change (who, caller, whether inside the raw-damage step, the defense or the turn resolution), every assignment to ability_scores, original_ability_scores, attack_power, magic_power, max_hp and original_max_hp (with the caller and whether a mod made it), the arguments and results of calculate_attribute with HP, stamina and injuries, and the charisma passed to document_emotion_scores_new next to the hero's two kinds of ability scores and the charisma bonus the loader's ability window adds. At the start of a battle, once per process for each combatant (by name and level), it calls the unwrapped raw-damage step with the random state reset each time and compares the result as is, with only attack power (magic power) doubled, with only ability_scores' strength (intelligence) +10, and with only original_ability_scores' +10; and calls the unwrapped get_npc_defense with each kind of ability scores +10. The changed values are put back at once and the random state is restored. Groundwork for a loader window that adds ability bonuses where the game reads them, and for reworking 802_equipment_ability_bonus on it. Read-only
description.ja: update_ability_scores / update_max_hp がいつ走り何を変えるか（誰か・呼び出し元・素点の計算や防御や手の解決の内側か）、ability_scores / original_ability_scores / attack_power / magic_power / max_hp / original_max_hp への代入（呼び出し元と MOD が書いたか）、calculate_attribute の引数と戻り（HP・スタミナ・部位の怪我と並べて）、document_emotion_scores_new に渡った魅力を、主人公の2つの能力値の魅力とローダの能力値の窓口が足す魅力の補正と並べて録る。戦闘の開始で1プロセス1回（相手の名前とレベルごと）、包む前の素の素点の計算を、乱数を毎回同じ状態に戻して、そのまま／攻撃力（魔力）だけ2倍／ability_scores の筋力（知力）だけ +10／original_ability_scores の同じ値だけ +10 で呼び比べ、包む前の素の get_npc_defense も2つの能力値を片方ずつ +10 して呼び比べる。変えた値はすぐ戻し、乱数の状態も戻す。能力値の補正をゲームが読む所で足すローダの窓口と、802_equipment_ability_bonus をそこへ乗せ替える下調べ。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない

note.ja: 1プロセスあたり。組み直し・代入・換算・魅力のそれぞれで、呼び出し元ごとにこの件数まで
note.en: Per process, for each kind (rebuild, assignment, conversion, charisma) and each caller

label.ja: 戦闘の開始で素点と防御を試す
label.en: Try raw damage and defense at battle start

note.ja: 攻撃力や能力値を一時だけ変えて、ゲームの素点と防御の計算に渡す。変えた値はすぐ戻し、乱数の状態も戻す。前後で HP や状態異常が動いたら、その場で止める
note.en: Hands the game's raw-damage and defense steps briefly changed values. They are put back at once and the random state is restored. Stops at once if HP or status changes
